caption: The drawing depicts a patterned quilt with five prominent red eight-pointed stars, each featuring yellow accents between the red points. The stars are distributed across the quilt, with one near the center and the rest near the corners. The background of the quilt is primarily off-white or cream. Surrounding the stars and filling much of the quilt's interior are numerous geometric triangular shapes, arranged in square blocks. These triangular shapes are composed of a variety of patterned fabrics, including blues, browns, reds, and tans, many of which exhibit checkered, striped, or dotted designs. The quilt appears bordered on two edges by a thin red binding with a white pattern. The composition is angular, with a strong presence of diagonal and triangular elements interspersed with the central star motif. The quilt is displayed against a plain, light background.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
